+    def _tool_call_index(

+        """Returns the slot of a streamed tool call delta.
+
+        Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint streams every parallel tool call whole
+        and without an index, which the client reads as `None`. Such a delta starts a
+        new call when it brings an id other than the latest call's, and otherwise
+        continues the latest call.
+        """
+        index = getattr(tool_call_delta, "index", None)
+        if index is not None:
+            return index
+        if not self.current_tools:
+            return 0
+        latest = max(self.current_tools)
+        if tool_call_delta.id and tool_call_delta.id != self.current_tools[latest][0]:
+            return latest + 1
+        return latest

+"""Tests for streamed tool calls that arrive without an index."""
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from typing import Any
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from openai.types.chat import ChatCompletionChunk
+
+from mirascope import llm
+
+
+@llm.tool
+def get_weather(city: str) -> str:
+    """Return the weather of a city."""
+    return f"{city}: cloudy"
+
+
+def make_chunk(
+    tool_calls: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], finish_reason: str | None = None
+) -> ChatCompletionChunk:
+    # The openai client builds streamed chunks without validating them, so a
+    # tool call delta the server sent without an index has `index=None`.
+    return ChatCompletionChunk.construct(
+        id="fixture-stream",
+        created=1,
+        model="gemini-3.5-flash",
+        object="chat.completion.chunk",
+        choices=[
+            {
+                "index": 0,
+                "delta": {"tool_calls": list(tool_calls) or None},
+                "finish_reason": finish_reason,
+            }
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+def tool_delta(id: str | None, name: str | None, arguments: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "id": id,
+        "type": "function" if id else None,
+        "function": {"name": name, "arguments": arguments},
+    }
+
+
+def stream_tool_calls(chunks: Sequence[ChatCompletionChunk]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
+    model = llm.Model("openai/gemini-3.5-flash:completions")
+    with patch(
+        "openai.resources.chat.completions.Completions.create",
+        return_value=iter(chunks),
+    ):
+        response = model.stream("Weather in Paris and London?", tools=[get_weather])
+        response.finish()
+    return [(tool_call.id, tool_call.args) for tool_call in response.tool_calls]
+
+
+def test_stream_whole_tool_calls_without_index() -> None:
+    """Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint sends each parallel call whole, without an index."""
+    assert stream_tool_calls(
+        [
+            make_chunk([tool_delta("call_paris", "get_weather", '{"city": "Paris"}')]),
+            make_chunk(
+                [tool_delta("call_london", "get_weather", '{"city": "London"}')]
+            ),
+            make_chunk([], finish_reason="tool_calls"),
+        ]
+    ) == [
+        ("call_paris", '{"city": "Paris"}'),
+        ("call_london", '{"city": "London"}'),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_stream_tool_call_fragments_without_index_continue_the_last_call() -> None:
+    assert stream_tool_calls(
+        [
+            make_chunk([tool_delta("call_paris", "get_weather", '{"city": ')]),
+            make_chunk([tool_delta("call_paris", None, '"Paris"}')]),
+            make_chunk([tool_delta("call_london", "get_weather", '{"ci')]),
+            make_chunk([tool_delta(None, None, 'ty": "London"}')]),
+            make_chunk([], finish_reason="tool_calls"),
+        ]
+    ) == [
+        ("call_paris", '{"city": "Paris"}'),
+        ("call_london", '{"city": "London"}'),
+    ]

+import type { ChatCompletionChunk } from "openai/resources/chat/completions";
+
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+
+import { createDecodeState, decodeStreamEvent } from "./decode-stream";
+
+function chunk(
+  toolCalls: Record<string, unknown>[],
+  finishReason: string | null = null,
+) {
+  return {
+    id: "chatcmpl-test",
+    created: 1,
+    model: "gemini-3.5-flash",
+    object: "chat.completion.chunk",
+    choices: [
+      {
+        index: 0,
+        delta: { tool_calls: toolCalls },
+        finish_reason: finishReason,
+      },
+    ],
+  } as unknown as ChatCompletionChunk;
+}
+
+function call(
+  id: string | undefined,
+  args: string,
+  name?: string,
+  index?: number,
+) {
+  return {
+    ...(index === undefined ? {} : { index }),
+    ...(id === undefined ? {} : { id }),
+    type: "function",
+    function: { ...(name === undefined ? {} : { name }), arguments: args },
+  };
+}
+
+function toolChunks(events: ChatCompletionChunk[]) {
+  const state = createDecodeState();
+  return events
+    .flatMap((event) => decodeStreamEvent(event, state))
+    .filter((part) => part.type.startsWith("tool_call_"));
+}
+
+describe("OpenAI-compatible streamed tool calls", () => {
+  it("keeps whole unindexed calls separate", () => {
+    expect(
+      toolChunks([
+        chunk([call("call_paris", '{"city":"Paris"}', "get_weather")]),
+        chunk([call("call_london", '{"city":"London"}', "get_weather")]),
+        chunk([], "tool_calls"),
+      ]),
+    ).toEqual([
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_start_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_paris",
+        name: "get_weather",
+      },
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_paris",
+        delta: '{"city":"Paris"}',
+      },
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_end_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_paris",
+      },
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_start_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_london",
+        name: "get_weather",
+      },
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_london",
+        delta: '{"city":"London"}',
+      },
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_end_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_london",
+      },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it("continues unindexed fragments with the same or missing id", () => {
+    expect(
+      toolChunks([
+        chunk([call("call_paris", '{"city":', "get_weather")]),
+        chunk([call("call_paris", '"Paris"}')]),
+        chunk([call("call_london", '{"city":', "get_weather")]),
+        chunk([call(undefined, '"London"}')]),
+        chunk([], "tool_calls"),
+      ]).filter((part) => part.type === "tool_call_chunk"),
+    ).toEqual([
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_paris",
+        delta: '{"city":',
+      },
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_paris",
+        delta: '"Paris"}',
+      },
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_london",
+        delta: '{"city":',
+      },
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_london",
+        delta: '"London"}',
+      },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it("keeps explicit indexes authoritative", () => {
+    expect(
+      toolChunks([
+        chunk([call("call_a", "{}", "get_weather", 0)]),
+        chunk([call("call_b", "{}", "get_weather", 1)]),
+        chunk([], "tool_calls"),
+      ]).filter((part) => part.type === "tool_call_start_chunk"),
+    ).toEqual([
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_start_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_a",
+        name: "get_weather",
+      },
+      {
+        type: "tool_call_start_chunk",
+        contentType: "tool_call",
+        id: "call_b",
+        name: "get_weather",
+      },
+    ]);
+  });
+});
